messages.author: Kalle Niskanen
messages.text:
Subject: Access road barrier at OULU-03

Hi team,

I was visiting site OULU-03 yesterday and noticed that the private access road now has a locked barrier.

If you get dispatched to OULU-03, the key for the barrier on the private road is at the neighbouring farm, ask for Mäkelä. I picked it up from him myself yesterday. Call ahead or just knock, it saves a wasted drive.

Best regards,
Kalle

notifications.text: Your tip from 2026-10-02 was used on OULU-03 today.
